description: Records something about the user that Garmin does not know: a goal, a race and its date, an injury, or a free-form note. Use this whenever the user mentions one in passing. It can also silence a finding the user has already accounted for — see `mutes`.

effective_to.description: ISO date this stops being true

kind.description: What sort of thing this is

text.description: What to remember, in the user's own words where possible

name: remember_context
